answers.how: shim.py:77 compares the short lowercased CAIRN_HOME_HOST (`host.split('.')[0].lower()`) to a lazy host_name() from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host, the comparison bus/server.py:1057 already makes. This widens a match: a CAIRN_HOME_HOST spelled with capitals or a domain now reads as this box, as it does for the bus.
answers.traces_to: Outline 6.6.3.7 (the hostname comes from the system device); outline 2.3.7.1.5 (the system device's host tool is one of the client tools a device publishes, the named exception to 2.3.7; a CC by-line builds, 0.4.1); outline 17.26.1 (a published client tool lives with its device); RULE 1 (the system device's public interface is the tool it publishes); Law 1 (one answer, not N re-derivations of it).
answers.what: The librarian names its host through the system device's host tool: cairn/devices/librarian/shim.py:77 read the host from cairn.devices.system_rackmount.tools.host.host and nowhere else, so this component names its box on every OS.
